programmes.d: Piers Morgan's book "Wake Up" is about America's divided society; a phone conversation Morgan had with Donald Trump; celebrities who have been "canceled" in 2020; tone-deaf mistakes of the rich and famous; keeping emotional health in check.

Dr. Phil and guests discuss cancel culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view.

Madison's parents say she now corrupts her 13-year-old sister, who has harsh words for them as emotions run high.
